# Whitespace Repair Drill

First sentence stands at the head of the paragraph. Second sentence stands at the tail of the paragraph.

    First sentence opens the indented continuation. Second sentence closes the indented continuation.

	First sentence opens the tab continuation. Second sentence closes the tab continuation.

  - First sentence opens the indented list item. Second sentence closes the indented list item.

First clause opens the passage. Remove this middle clause from the passage. Third clause closes the passage.

Only sentence stands alone on its own line in the passage.

    Only sentence stands alone inside the indented block of the passage.
